hardware_from_same_host.conditions: Shared developer workstation; warm source cache; CPU power/thermal state uncontrolled. Final candidates run sequentially. RSS covers the entire benchmark process, including correctness/recovery, not just ingestion.

protocol.input: frozen private actual traces; no synthetic performance workload
protocol.sizes: all immutable packs and manifests; disposable catalog reported separately
protocol.timing: exploratory; compilation and experiments sometimes overlap; no throughput comparison claimed
protocol.reader: Nenia 0.2 portable codec; no default Preflate dependency
protocol.native_formats: Codex Zstd 1.5.7, PNG exact generic/fdeflate/zlib reconstruction, JPEG exact Lepton/opaque reconstruction
protocol.reference_depth: media pack dependencies are only ordinary format-1 packs
